stories.title: Survey vessel 'Ikshak' to be commissioned at Kochi (6 November)
stories.body: the Navy's third ship of her survey class.

stories.title: Sulakshana Pandit died in Mumbai on 6 November, aged 71
stories.body: playback singer and actress who won the Filmfare Best Female Playback Singer award in 1976 for "Tu Hi Sagar Tu Hi Kinara" (Sankalp); sister of Jatin–Lalit and niece of Pandit Jasraj.

one_liners: Survey vessel 'Ikshak' to be commissioned at Kochi (6 November) — the Navy's third ship of her survey class.
Sulakshana Pandit died in Mumbai on 6 November, aged 71 — playback singer and actress who won the Filmfare Best Female Playback Singer award in 1976 for "Tu Hi Sagar Tu Hi Kinara"…
